speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling unusually slow or irregular?

speaker: Patient
text: No, my heart rate feels normal to me; I haven't noticed any irregular beats or a sensation of it being unusually slow. I just feel generally sluggish and tired all the time. speaker: Doctor
text: That is interesting; pneumonia can sometimes cause fatigue, but it does not typically explain weight gain or cold intolerance. Given the chest CT findings, have you been experiencing any fever, cough, or shortness of breath recently?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had a fever, cough, or any trouble breathing. I've been feeling perfectly fine in that regard, but the fatigue and weight gain are definitely getting worse. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypothyroidism with incidental pneumonia.
